shortDescription: PALOS VERDES ESTATES, Calif., Sept. 11, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Malaga Financial Corporation OTCIQ:MLGF announced today the declaration of a cash dividend in the amount of 25 cents per share to shareholders of record on September 23, 2026. The dividend will be paid out on or about October 1, 2026…

children: announced today the declaration of a cash dividend in the amount of 25 cents per share to shareholders of record on September 23, 2026. The dividend will be paid out on or about October 1, 2026. Randy C. Bowers, Chairman, President and CEO, remarked, “We are pleased to reward our loyal shareholders with this 25-cent quarterly dividend which represents a 4.45% annualized yield based on our most recent closing price of $22.46. We are grateful for the efforts of our colleagues which has positioned us to declare this 89th consecutive quarterly cash dividend.”
Malaga Bank, a subsidiary of Malaga Financial Corporation, is a full-service community bank headquartered on the Palos Verdes Peninsula with six offices located in the South Bay area of Los Angeles.
